statement: ∀ (E₀ : Set (YEuclid 0)) (x : YEuclid 0), E₀ = Set.univ → yJoin x '' yI = yProd E₀
proof:
intro E₀ x hE
have hlast (t : ℝ) : yJoin x t (Fin.last 0) = t := by
  exact Fin.snoc_last (α := fun _ : Fin 1 => ℝ) (x := t) (p := fun i => x i)
apply Set.Subset.antisymm
· rintro z ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
  constructor
  · rw [hE]
    trivial
  · change yJoin x t (Fin.last 0) ∈ yI
    rwa [hlast]
· intro z hz
  refine ⟨yVert z, hz.2, ?_⟩
  ext i
  have hi : i = Fin.last 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hi, hlast]
  rfl
